title: Carvera Controller C# layout
description: Generated from the component catalog. Do not edit by hand.

theme.description: Theme tokens, e.g. accent, background, surface, text, fontFamily, fontSize.

key.description: Key gesture, e.g. Ctrl+Up, F5, Escape.

class.description: Named style(s) from the layout's 'styles', applied in order.

width.description: Omitted = fill the available width. Number = pixels, "30%", "2*" (weighted share) or "auto" (fit content).

height.description: Omitted = fill the available height. Same forms as width.

margin.description: Space outside the element, CSS order: 8 | "8 4" | "t r b l".

align.description: Horizontal placement when the element is narrower than its slot.

valign.description: Vertical placement when the element is shorter than its slot.

visible.description: false hides the element; an expression shows it conditionally.

enabled.description: false or an expression that disables the element.

style.description: Visual properties applied to this element.

visuals.description: Visual properties (including images) per state, e.g. { "hover": {...}, "disabled": {...} }.

conditions.description: Array of { "when": expression, ...visual properties }. Matching entries apply in order, last wins.

x.description: Canvas: left offset in pixels or percent.

y.description: Canvas: top offset in pixels or percent.

title.description: Tabs: the tab header. Panel: the caption.

region.description: Use a named region from 'regions'; other properties here override the region's.

then.description: Lays children out in a row or column. Children without a size share the free space equally.

justify.description: Where leftover space goes when no child fills it.

then.description: Rows and columns. Children choose a cell with row/column (and rowSpan/columnSpan).
Two or more panes separated by draggable splitters.

sizes.description: Initial pane sizes; default is equal shares.

then.description: Shows one child at a time; each child's 'title' is its tab header.
Scrolls a single child that is larger than the available space.
Free placement: children are positioned with x/y and sized with width/height. Uncovered areas stay empty.
A framed region with an optional caption. Children are stacked like 'stack'.

collapsible.description: Lets the user collapse the panel by clicking its caption.

then.description: Static or live text: "X {axis.x.work:0.000}".
A labelled live value.

bind.description: State path or expression to show.

orientation.description: Caption beside (horizontal) or above (vertical) the value.

then.description: Position of one axis in work, machine and/or offset coordinates.

show.description: Any of work, machine, offset (in display order).

label.description: Axis caption; defaults to the axis letter.

orientation.description: Caption beside or above the numbers.

command.description: Command to run (see the command reference).

then.description: Machine state (Idle, Run, Alarm...) with a colour per state.
A lamp that is on or off according to an expression.

lampSize.description: Diameter of the default lamp; 0 hides it.

then.description: A progress bar.
A picture. Use 'visuals'/'conditions' to swap it by state.

stretch.description: How the image fills its box.

then.description: Empty space. Give it a size, or leave it unsized to absorb free space.
Runs a command when clicked.

command.description: Command to run (see the command reference).

confirm.description: Ask for confirmation with this message first.

then.description: An on/off switch bound to machine state.

command.description: Command to run (see the command reference).

then.description: A row or column of mutually exclusive options.

command.description: Command to run (see the command reference).

argName.description: Argument that receives the option value (default 'value').

optionVisuals.description: Visuals for each option button (normal, hover, pressed, disabled, selected).

then.description: Jog step selector (a 'choice' preset).
Work coordinate system selector G54-G59 (a 'choice' preset).
A slider that sends a command when released.

command.description: Command to run (see the command reference).

then.description: Feed, spindle or laser override: value, slider, -/+ and reset to 100%.

buttonVisuals.description: Visuals for the -, + and reset buttons.

then.description: Jog buttons for the chosen axes, using the current jog step and feed.

axes.description: Axes to include: X, Y, Z, A (default X, Y, Z).

buttonVisuals.description: Visuals applied to every jog button.

images.description: Per-button images, keyed X+, X-, Y+, Y-, Z+, Z-, A+, A-, X+Y+ ... e.g. { "X+": "assets/right.svg" }.

then.description: Manual command entry with history (Up/Down).

buttonText.description: Send button caption; empty hides the button.

then.description: Machine traffic and messages.
Connect/disconnect: Wi-Fi address, USB port or the built-in simulator, with network discovery.

kinds.description: Connection kinds offered (default wifi, usb, simulator).

then.description: 3D view of the loaded G-code and the tool, navigated like Blender: middle-drag orbits, Shift+middle-drag pans, Ctrl+middle-drag or wheel zooms, numpad 1/3/7 (Ctrl: opposite) align front/right/top, numpad 5 toggles perspective, 2/4/6/8 orbit, 9 flips, . frames the tool, Home frames all. Alt+left-drag replaces the middle button; the corner gizmo can be clicked or dragged.

showGrid.description: Draw the XY grid at Z0 (default true).

toolLength.description: Length of the drawn tool in mm (default 25).

doneColor.description: Moves already executed by the running job.

colorBy.description: Colour feed moves per operation (default) or all alike with pathColor.

then.description: The loaded G-code file with a colour bar per operation. Follows the scrub position (or the running job); clicking a line scrubs to it.
Scrubs through the loaded G-code: slider, step and operation-jump buttons, play/pause, and the line at the scrub position.

speed.description: Path segments per second while playing (default 150).

showLine.description: Show the operation and G-code line under the slider (default true).

buttonVisuals.description: Visuals applied to the scrubber buttons.

then.description: The operations (toolpaths) in the loaded G-code with their colour, lines and tool. The tool can be changed per operation; click an operation to show it alone.

tools.description: Tool numbers offered in addition to those in the file (default 1-6).

then.description: The tools the loaded G-code uses: number, description, diameter, type and the operations that use each. Highlights the tool in the spindle and the one at the scrub position.
Switches between the available layout files.

background.description: Fill colour, e.g. #FFFFFF or a theme token such as @surface.

image.description: Image file (SVG, PNG, JPG) relative to the layout file, or builtin:<name>.

imagePlacement.description: Where the image sits relative to the text. 'fill' stretches it behind the content.

text.description: Replaces the element's text in this state.
